label: Space group
definition: The group of all symmetry operations (rotation part W with translation w) of a three-dimensional crystal pattern; agentsg builds each of the 230 from Hall-symbol generators by closure.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Symmetry operation (Seitz operator)
definition: An affine map x' = W x + w with integer rotation part W (det ±1) and rational translation w, composed and inverted exactly; written as an ITA xyz triplet.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Point group (rotation parts)
definition: The set of distinct rotation parts W of a space group; agentsg derives it from the operator list rather than a table.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Laue class / Laue group
definition: The point group obtained by adding inversion; used because Friedel's law makes diffraction centrosymmetric, e.g. for reindexing cosets and reflection multiplicities.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Holohedry (lattice point group)
definition: The full point group of a lattice: all rotations leaving its metric tensor invariant; determined numerically from the 81 Lebedev two-folds.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Centrosymmetry / inversion centre
definition: Presence of the operation −I (x → −x); tested on the point group.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Inversion (−1) operation
definition: The symmetry operation W = −I; Laue groups are point groups closed under it.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Group closure by composition
definition: Generate the full operation set from generators by repeated composition modulo lattice translations; terminates because a space-group order is bounded by 192 in the conventional cell.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Generators of a group
definition: A small set of elements whose products generate the whole group; Hall symbols encode space-group generators.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Hall space-group symbol
definition: Compact notation (Hall 1981) encoding the lattice centring and generator operations of a space group, including an optional origin shift in twelfths; parsed into generators.
literature: Hall, S. R. (1981). Acta Cryst. A37, 517;ITA Vol. B 1.4
:LABEL: Concept

label: Hermann–Mauguin symbol
definition: The international (ITA) symbol of a space group or point group; agentsg resolves HM, Hall and number, and prints extended HM symbols with a parenthesised change of basis.
:LABEL: Concept

label: ITA settings (origin choice, cell choice, unique axis)
definition: The alternative descriptions of one space-group type tabulated in International Tables Vol. A (origin choices 1/2, hexagonal/rhombohedral axes, unique axes), each with its own Hall symbol.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Extended setting notation (symbol + change of basis)
definition: A base space-group symbol followed by a parenthesised change of basis, e.g. 'C 2y (x+y,z,x-y)'; when det P ≠ 1 the transform introduces centring translations.
literature: Zwart, Grosse-Kunstleve & Adams, Exploring Metric Symmetry, IUCr Comp. Comm. Newsletter 7 (2006)
:LABEL: Concept

label: Change of basis / coordinate transformation (P, p)
definition: A transformation of the crystallographic basis and origin: (a',b',c') = (a,b,c)P, x' = P⁻¹(x − p), W' = P⁻¹WP, and Miller indices transform covariantly h' = hP.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Covariant / contravariant transformation
definition: Fractional coordinates transform with P⁻¹ (contravariantly) while Miller indices, dual to the basis, transform with P so that h·x stays invariant.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Origin shift
definition: Translation p of the coordinate origin; conjugates each operator to (W, w + (I − W)p) and multiplies structure factors by the phase exp(2πi h·p) without changing h.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Conjugation of a group element
definition: Mapping g ↦ h g h⁻¹; applied with a translation h = (I, p) it re-expresses a space group in a shifted origin, and with a basis change it re-expresses W as P⁻¹WP.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Lattice centring (P, A, B, C, I, F, R)
definition: Additional pure translations of a conventional cell; derived in agentsg as the operations with W = I and used for integral reflection conditions and primitive-cell reduction.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Bravais lattice
definition: One of the 14 translation-lattice types in three dimensions; distinguished by holohedry and centring.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Lattice (translation lattice)
definition: The set of all integer combinations of three basis vectors; the translation subgroup of a space group, including centring vectors.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Integer lattice Zⁿ and sublattices
definition: Z³ as the lattice of fractional coordinates; sublattices, saturated sublattices and their bases are handled with integer (unimodular) column and row reduction.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Crystal system
definition: Classification of point groups (triclinic … cubic); in agentsg the metric restrictions of each system follow from WᵀGW = G rather than a table.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Crystal family / lattice family
definition: The six families (triclinic, monoclinic, orthorhombic, tetragonal, hexagonal, cubic) decided from rotation orders and their fixed axes.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Crystallographic restriction theorem
definition: Rotations compatible with a lattice have orders 1, 2, 3, 4 or 6 and are integer matrices in a lattice basis; agentsg's order test only searches k ≤ 6.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Symmetry element
definition: The geometric locus (axis, plane, point) together with the intrinsic translation of an operation; agentsg classifies (W, w) exactly, reducing w modulo the lattice.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Screw axis
definition: A rotation combined with a translation along the axis; causes serial reflection conditions such as 00l: l = 2n for 2₁ along c.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Glide plane
definition: A reflection combined with a translation parallel to the plane (a, b, c, n, d, e glides); causes zonal reflection conditions.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Rotoinversion axis
definition: An improper operation: rotation followed by inversion (−N in Hall symbols).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Mirror plane
definition: A reflection with zero intrinsic translation; its fixed subspace in reciprocal space is a zone of reflections.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Intrinsic (screw/glide) translation
definition: The component of w parallel to the fixed space of W, reduced to the shortest lattice-equivalent representative; zero for pure rotations and mirrors.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Fixed-point locus of an operation
definition: The affine subspace of points x with W x + w ≡ x (mod lattice), found by solving (W − I)x = −w exactly; its dimension gives point, line or plane.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Fixed subspace / +1 eigenspace of W
definition: The kernel of (W − I): directions left invariant by a rotation; in reciprocal space (row action) it defines reflection strata, in direct space floating origins and axis directions.
:LABEL: Concept

label: ITA space-group diagrams (general position, symmetry elements)
definition: The International Tables plates: projected general-position orbit with heights and handedness, and the symmetry-element diagram with graphical symbols; rendered from the derived operations.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Wyckoff position
definition: A set of points with conjugate site-symmetry groups; agentsg computes multiplicity, site-symmetry order and locus dimension from the operations (Wyckoff letters are not reproduced).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Site symmetry (stabilizer of a point)
definition: The subgroup of operations fixing a point modulo lattice translations; its order divides the group order.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Crystallographic orbit
definition: The set of images of a point under the space group, reduced into the unit cell; its size is |G|/|S(x)| (orbit–stabilizer).
:LABEL: Concept

label: General position
definition: A point with trivial site symmetry; its multiplicity equals the order of the space group in the conventional cell.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Stabilizer (group action)
definition: For a group acting on a set, the subgroup fixing a given element; used for sites (direct space) and for reflection strata (reciprocal space).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Orbit (group action)
definition: The set of images of an element under a group; point-group orbits of Miller indices give symmetry-equivalent reflections.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Orbit–stabilizer theorem
definition: |orbit| = |G| / |stabilizer|; gives Wyckoff multiplicities and reflection multiplicities (|Laue group| / epsilon).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Group action
definition: A group acting on a set (points by x ↦ Wx + w, Miller indices by h ↦ hW, lattices by G ↦ MᵀGM).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Miller indices
definition: Integer triple (h, k, l) labelling a reflection / lattice plane; treated as a row vector acting by h' = hW.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reciprocal lattice / reciprocal space
definition: The dual lattice of the direct lattice; reflections are its nodes and the reciprocal metric tensor is G⁻¹.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Structure-factor phase shift under symmetry
definition: An operation (W, w) fixing h multiplies F(h) by exp(2πi h·w); the phase h·w in turns decides absences and phase restrictions.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Structure factor
definition: F(h) = Σ f_j exp(2πi h·x_j); its symmetry properties (absences, centric phases, semi-invariants) are what agentsg derives from the operators.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Systematic absences (extinctions)
definition: A reflection h is absent iff some operation fixes h (hW = h) with non-integral phase h·w; the single rule from which all reflection conditions are derived.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reflection conditions
definition: Generator-derived congruences for which reflections can be present, pruned against the Smith-form lattice of each stratum and reported as integral, zonal, and serial conditions. Not a transcription of the International Tables lists.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Integral reflection conditions
definition: Conditions on all hkl arising from lattice centring, e.g. F: h+k, h+l = 2n.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Zonal reflection conditions
definition: Conditions on a zone (hk0, h0l, 0kl, hhl …) arising from glide planes.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Serial reflection conditions
definition: Conditions on a row (h00, 0k0, 00l …) arising from screw axes.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reflection stratum (class with a given stabilizer)
definition: The set of reciprocal-lattice vectors with the same stabilizer in the point group; the generic part of a rational subspace, computed as the intersection closure of fixed subspaces — exactly the ITA reflection classes hkl, 0kl, h00, hhl….
:LABEL: Concept

label: Augmented translation lattice Λ_S and its dual
definition: On a stratum the operations with W in the stabilizer act like pure translations, so present reflections are the dual of Λ_S = Z³ + ⟨w⟩; the same construction with allowed origins gives the semi-invariants.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Centric reflection / phase restriction
definition: A reflection mapped to −h by some operation has its phase restricted to two values; agentsg reports absence, centricity and the restricted phase (SgInfo semantics).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Friedel's law
definition: |F(h)| = |F(−h)| in the absence of anomalous scattering, so the diffraction pattern has the Laue symmetry.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Symmetry-equivalent reflections
definition: The orbit of h under the point group (with Friedel mates); its size is the reflection multiplicity.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Epsilon factor (reflection stabilizer order)
definition: The number of point-group operations fixing h; the expected intensity enhancement factor ε of Wilson statistics.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reciprocal-space asymmetric unit
definition: A set of unique reflections under the Laue group (CCP4/cctbx/gemmi convention); agentsg maps hkl into it.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Allowed (permissible) origins
definition: Origin shifts o with (W − I)o ∈ L for all W, which leave the operator set unchanged; they form a group T' ⊇ L whose discrete part is the set of alternative origins.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Floating origin (polar direction)
definition: A continuous origin freedom along the common +1 eigenspace of all rotation parts (kernel of the stacked W − I); zero invariant factors of the Smith form.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Euclidean normalizer (Cheshire group)
definition: The normalizer of a space group in the Euclidean group; its translation part is exactly the group of allowed origin shifts.
literature: ITA Vol. A Chapter 3.5 (Euclidean and affine normalizers)
:LABEL: Concept

label: Normalizer of a subgroup
definition: N_G(H) = {g : gHg⁻¹ = H}; the largest subgroup in which H is normal.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Structure seminvariant
definition: A reflection (or linear combination) whose phase is unchanged by every allowed origin shift: h·o ∈ Z for all o ∈ T'; the dual lattice of the allowed-origin group, reported as congruences (vector, modulus).
literature: SgInfo (Grosse-Kunstleve) TabTrial_si;Giacovazzo, Direct Phasing in Crystallography
:LABEL: Concept

label: Direct methods (context)
definition: Phase determination from structure-factor statistics; seminvariants and origin definition are its group-theoretical foundation.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Patterson function / vectors
definition: The autocorrelation of the electron density; peaks at interatomic vectors u = x_i − x_j.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Harker sections and lines
definition: Loci of self-Patterson vectors u = (I − W)x − w; each left-null vector n of (I − W) gives a constraint n·u ≡ −n·w (mod 1) defining a plane, line or point.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Asymmetric unit (fundamental domain)
definition: A region containing exactly one representative of each orbit; agentsg provides the conventional brick and a metric Dirichlet/Voronoi domain.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Dirichlet / Voronoi domain of an orbit
definition: The set of points closer to a seed than to any of its orbit mates, bounded by bisecting half-spaces; a metric asymmetric unit whose shape depends on the origin gauge.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Voronoi cell
definition: The region of points nearer to one site of a point set than to any other.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Half-space / convex polytope
definition: A region n·x ≤ c; intersections of half-spaces define the Dirichlet ASU facets.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Monte-Carlo estimation
definition: Random sampling used to estimate ASU volume fraction, inertia eigenvalues and sphericity.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Second-moment (inertia) tensor and sphericity
definition: The 3×3 second-moment matrix of a region; the ratio λ_min/λ_max of its eigenvalues scores how spherical a domain is.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Isoperimetric quotient
definition: 36πV²/A³, equal to 1 only for a ball; agentsg estimates a proxy for ASU compactness.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Subgroup
definition: A subset closed under the group operation; maximal subgroups of a space group are derived from the operator list.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Translationengleiche (t) subgroup
definition: A subgroup with the same translation lattice and a smaller point group (type I).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Klassengleiche (k) subgroup
definition: A subgroup with the same point group and fewer translations (type II): dropping centring (IIa) or an enlarged cell / invariant sublattice (IIb).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Index of a subgroup / coset
definition: The number of cosets of H in G; index-2 subgroups are kernels of homomorphisms G → C₂ found by nullspaces over GF(2).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Coset decomposition
definition: Partition of a group into translates gH of a subgroup; reindexing operators and twin laws are coset representatives of the Laue group in the lattice symmetry group.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Linear algebra over GF(2)
definition: Nullspaces of 0/1 matrices modulo 2, used to enumerate homomorphisms onto C₂ (index-2 subgroups).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Group homomorphism and kernel
definition: A structure-preserving map between groups; its kernel is a normal subgroup (index-2 subgroups = kernels of maps to C₂).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Group theory (finite and crystallographic groups)
definition: The algebra of symmetry: closure, subgroups, cosets, normalizers, actions; the foundation of every derived object in agentsg.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Symmetric group S₄ (superbase relabellings)
definition: The 24 permutations of the four superbase labels, extended by −I to order 48; realised as integer unimodular changes of basis.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Unit cell
definition: The parallelepiped (a, b, c, α, β, γ) spanned by a lattice basis; agentsg treats it numerically via its metric tensor.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Metric tensor (Gram matrix)
definition: G_ij = a_i·a_j; squared lengths are xᵀGx, volume² = det G, and a basis change acts by G' = PᵀGP.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Gram matrix
definition: The matrix of inner products of a set of vectors; symmetric positive definite for a basis.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reciprocal metric tensor and reciprocal cell
definition: G* = G⁻¹; gives d-spacings via 1/d² = hᵀG*h and the reciprocal cell parameters.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Interplanar spacing d(hkl) and Bragg angle
definition: d = 1/|h a* + k b* + l c*|; 2θ from Bragg's law λ = 2d sin θ.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Bragg's law
definition: nλ = 2d sin θ, relating diffraction angle to interplanar spacing.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Orthogonalization / fractionalization matrix
definition: The matrix M with Cartesian = M·fractional (a along x, b in xy) and its inverse.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Unit-cell volume
definition: V = abc√(1 − cos²α − cos²β − cos²γ + 2cosα cosβ cosγ) = √det G.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Metric invariance WᵀGW = G
definition: A point-group operation leaves the metric tensor invariant; this single identity yields the crystal-system restrictions, metric symmetrisation and the free-parameter count.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Neumann's principle (context)
definition: Physical properties (here the metric) are invariant under the point group of the crystal.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reynolds operator (group averaging)
definition: Projection onto the invariant subspace by averaging over the group: G_sym = (1/|G|) Σ WᵀGW; used to symmetrise metrics and to score two-folds.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Projection onto a subspace
definition: An idempotent linear map onto a subspace; metric symmetrisation projects onto the point-group-invariant metrics.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Primitive cell / conventional-to-primitive transformation
definition: A cell containing one lattice point; ITA Table 5.1.3.1 matrices with det P = 1/m take the conventional centred cell to it (G_P = PᵀGP), validated against the centring vectors.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Primitive basis of a (centred) lattice
definition: A Z-basis of L = Z³ + ⟨centring⟩ obtained by row Hermite normal form; used to write allowed origins in integral coordinates.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Conventional cell
definition: The standard (possibly centred) cell of ITA whose axes follow the symmetry; identification returns the ITA type in this cell even for primitive inputs.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reduced cell
definition: A unique canonical cell of a lattice (Niggli or Delaunay/Selling reduced) that removes the infinite basis ambiguity.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Niggli reduction (Křivý–Gruber, Grosse-Kunstleve stabilised)
definition: Iterative reduction of the metric scalars (A, B, C, ξ, η, ζ) with tolerance-aware comparisons, tracking the integer change of basis M with MᵀGM = G_reduced.
literature: Grosse-Kunstleve, Sauter & Adams (2004). Acta Cryst. A60, 1-6;Křivý & Gruber (1976). Acta Cryst. A32, 297
:LABEL: Concept

label: Delaunay / Selling reduction to an obtuse superbase
definition: Reduce a lattice basis to four zero-sum vectors with all pairwise scalar products ≤ 0 by repeated Selling flips; the reduced superbase is unique up to a finite closure.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Obtuse superbase
definition: Four vectors v0..v3 summing to zero with all v_i·v_j ≤ 0; its conorms p_ij = −v_i·v_j (six) and vonorms (seven) are lattice invariants.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Voronoi (Delaunay) type of a lattice V1–V5
definition: The five combinatorial types of three-dimensional Voronoi cells, classified from the zero conorms of the obtuse superbase; higher types have several non-isometric superbase classes.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Selling-superbase closure
definition: The complete finite set of obtuse superbases of one lattice (S₄×{±I} orbit at V1, plus extra classes at V2–V5); enumerated for exact reindexing and identity certification. Zero conorms use a relative floor of 1e-9, widened by three angle-sigma widths (default 0.05 degrees), and a relative boundary width of 1e-3.
literature: Zwart, agentsg manuscript: 'The Selling closure for lattice comparison'
:LABEL: Concept

label: Kurlin root products / root form (isometry invariant)
definition: Six root products r_ij = √p_ij of the obtuse superbase; Kurlin's ordered 2×3 root form is a complete isometry invariant, agentsg's globally sorted 6-tuple is a continuous (but not complete) Euclidean search key.
literature: Kurlin, V. Mathematics of 2-dimensional and 3-dimensional lattices, arXiv:2201.10543
:LABEL: Concept

label: Rearrangement inequality
definition: For sorted vectors ‖sort(x) − sort(y)‖ ≤ min_σ ‖x − σy‖; makes the sorted root key a conservative lower bound on the orbit distance.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Similarity (scale-free) invariant
definition: The sorted root key divided by V^{1/3}, invariant under isotropic scaling; separates shape from volume in lattice comparison.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Space of lattices / lattice manifold
definition: Treating lattices as points of a continuous space (G6, S6, root form) so that comparison, symmetry deficiency and nearest-neighbour search become geometric.
:LABEL: Concept

label: G6 / S6 lattice embeddings (Andrews–Bernstein)
definition: G6 = (a·a, b·b, c·c, 2b·c, 2a·c, 2a·b) (Niggli) and S6 = the six Selling scalars; boundary-aware distances minimise over reduction-boundary transforms.
literature: Andrews & Bernstein (1988). Acta Cryst. A44, 1009;Andrews & Bernstein (2014). J. Appl. Cryst. 47, 346
:LABEL: Concept

label: Symmetry deficiency (distance to a holohedry)
definition: A continuous measure of how far a lattice is from a given point-group subspace: distance from the cell to its Reynolds-symmetrised cell.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Pseudo-symmetry / metric pseudo-symmetry
definition: Approximate symmetry of the lattice metric beyond the crystal's true symmetry, quantified by Le Page delta and tolerance.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Metric lattice symmetry (Le Page / Lebedev)
definition: Find the holohedry of a measured cell: test the 81 Lebedev two-folds (integer {−1,0,1} matrices) by the Le Page angle between direct and reciprocal axes, then close the accepted set. The default cutoff is 3 degrees and the length gate is 2 percent.
literature: Le Page (1982). J. Appl. Cryst. 15, 255;Lebedev, Vagin & Murshudov (2006). Acta Cryst. D62, 83;Zwart, Grosse-Kunstleve & Adams (2006)
:LABEL: Concept

label: Cell comparison by sublattice search (lego / target)
definition: Niggli-reduce two cells, take the integer volume ratio r, enumerate index-r sublattices of the smaller cell in Hermite normal form, and accept those whose reduced metric matches the larger cell.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Sublattice / superlattice and index
definition: A subgroup of finite index in a lattice; index-d sublattices of Z³ are enumerated as integer matrices of determinant d in Hermite normal form (count Σ_{adf=n} a²d).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Saturated sublattice (V ∩ Z³)
definition: The integer points of a rational subspace; obtained by unimodular column reduction (integer kernel) so the basis is primitive.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Dual lattice
definition: L* = {h : h·t ∈ Z for all t ∈ L}; for augmented lattices the dual is computed from one Smith normal form as invariant factors, index, basis and congruences.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Dual basis
definition: The basis a*, b*, c* with a_i·a*_j = δ_ij; Miller indices are coordinates in it.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reindexing operators (coset P·H)
definition: Integer operators relating two settings of the same lattice; never unique — the full answer is the coset P·H of the lattice symmetry group H = {M : MᵀG_AM = G_A}.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Indexing ambiguity (serial crystallography)
definition: When the lattice holohedry exceeds the Laue group, frames can be indexed in |M_lattice|/|L_Laue| inequivalent ways; the operators are left-coset representatives, resolved by intensity correlation.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Twinning by (pseudo-)merohedry and twin laws
definition: When the lattice symmetry H is larger than the crystal's Laue group L, the cosets of L in H are the twin domains and their representatives the twin laws.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Deformation manifold with landmarks (path-consistent reindexing)
definition: Under continuous lattice deformation reindexing is path-dependent (monodromy); a scaffold of landmark states with a k-NN graph, shortest paths and a Fiedler coordinate keeps the frame consistent.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Space-group identification from operators
definition: Match a closed operator set to one of the 230 types up to origin shift and an integer change of basis (|det P| ≤ 4), solving (W − I)p = Δw exactly and expanding centring cosets.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Settings of a space group under the Selling group
definition: The 48 (distinct fewer) reindexed descriptions of one group obtained by sweeping the order-48 Selling change-of-basis group.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Nearest-neighbour search on lattice keys
definition: Find lattices closest to a query in root-invariant space: exact k-NN and radius queries.
:LABEL: Concept

label: k-d tree
definition: Space-partitioning tree for Euclidean nearest-neighbour queries (scipy cKDTree over 6-D root keys).
:LABEL: Concept

label: NearTree (metric-space index)
definition: A tree that prunes searches with the triangle inequality only, valid for any metric (needed for boundary-aware G6/S6 distances that are not Euclidean norms).
literature: Andrews, L. C. (2001). J. Appl. Cryst. 34, 663-668
:LABEL: Concept

label: Metric space and the triangle inequality
definition: A set with a distance satisfying symmetry and d(x,z) ≤ d(x,y) + d(y,z); the property NearTree pruning relies on.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Euclidean (L2) distance
definition: ‖x − y‖₂ on the six sorted root products (Å) or on G6/S6 (Å²).
:LABEL: Concept

label: k-nearest-neighbour graph
definition: Graph joining each lattice state to its k nearest states by key distance; the scaffold of the deformation manifold.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Dijkstra's shortest-path algorithm
definition: Shortest weighted paths from a source; routes each state to its nearest landmark.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Graph Laplacian and Fiedler vector
definition: L = D − A; the eigenvector of the second-smallest eigenvalue orders the states along the deformation.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Farthest-point (k-center) sampling
definition: Greedy selection of landmarks that maximise the minimum distance to those already chosen.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Pearson correlation coefficient
definition: Normalised covariance of two intensity sets; picks the reindexing branch that best matches a reference.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Singular value decomposition / principal components
definition: Mean-centred SVD of the n×6 matrix of hit-set root keys gives the PC1–PC2 plane used to display a PDB search.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Convex hull
definition: Smallest convex set containing given points; used to outline coordination polyhedra on cubic plates.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Floating-point tolerance / stabilised comparison
definition: Relative epsilons replacing exact equality in numeric reductions and symmetry tests, so near-degenerate cells neither cycle nor misclassify.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Periodic (torus) distance in fractional coordinates
definition: Distance on the unit torus obtained by reducing coordinate differences into (−½, ½]; used for stabilisers and diagram layout.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Exact rational arithmetic (no fixed denominator)
definition: All symmetry algebra uses Python Fractions so 1/2, 1/3, 1/12, 1/60 combine exactly; the deliberate alternative to cctbx's fixed translation base factor.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Determinant
definition: det of a 3×3 matrix (exact by cofactor expansion, integer by elimination); ±1 for crystallographic rotations, index for sublattice matrices, V² for the metric.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Matrix inverse (cofactor / adjugate, unimodular integer inverse)
definition: Exact inverse via cofactors over Q; for unimodular integer matrices the inverse is integer.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Gaussian elimination / reduced row echelon form
definition: Row reduction over the rationals with pivot tracking; the workhorse for solving (W − I)x = −w, rank and nullspaces.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Solving linear and affine systems over Q
definition: M x = rhs and (W − I)x = −w (mod 1) solved exactly, returning particular solutions and free directions.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Kernel / nullspace (rational and integer)
definition: {x : Ax = 0}; over Q from rref, over Z as a saturated basis by unimodular column reduction.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Left nullspace
definition: {n : nᵀM = 0}; each left-null vector of (I − W) is a Harker constraint normal.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Matrix rank
definition: Number of independent rows/columns, exact over Q or numeric with pivoting; decides plane/line/point loci and free metric parameters.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Affine subspace
definition: A translate of a linear subspace; solution sets of (W − I)x = −w and Harker loci are affine flats.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Affine transformation
definition: x ↦ Wx + w; the form of every crystallographic symmetry operation and change of basis.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Eigenvalues of a symmetric 3×3 matrix
definition: Real eigenvalues from the characteristic cubic (closed-form roots) for inertia and Laplacian analyses.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Eigenvector
definition: A vector mapped to a multiple of itself; the +1 eigenvector of a two-fold is its axis.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Unimodular integer matrix / GL(3, Z)
definition: Integer matrices with det ±1; lattice-preserving changes of basis; the 480 Lebedev matrices with entries in {−1,0,1} and finite order.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Hermite normal form
definition: Canonical upper-triangular form of an integer matrix under unimodular row (or column) operations; gives a unique basis per lattice and enumerates sublattices.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Smith normal form and invariant factors
definition: U A V = diag(s₁, s₂, s₃) with U, V unimodular and s_i | s_{i+1}; the invariant factors classify the quotient of a lattice by a sublattice (zero → free, 1 → trivial, s > 1 → cyclic torsion).
:LABEL: Concept

label: Finitely generated abelian groups (torsion and free parts)
definition: Every such group is ⊕Z/s_i ⊕ Z^r; the allowed-origin group modulo the lattice is Z^{floating} ⊕ torsion, read off the Smith form.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Linear congruence f·c ≡ 0 (mod m)
definition: Integer conditions on index coefficients; the form in which reflection conditions (k+l = 4n), semi-invariants and Harker constraints are stated.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Modular arithmetic (mod 1 and mod m)
definition: Translations reduced modulo the lattice (mod 1) and integer congruences modulo m.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Greatest common divisor / least common multiple
definition: Used to clear denominators, remove content from integer vectors and choose moduli.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Order of a matrix / group element
definition: Smallest n with Wⁿ = I; 1, 2, 3, 4 or 6 for crystallographic rotations.
:LABEL: Concept

label: ITA graphical symbols for symmetry elements
definition: The International Tables glyphs for axes and planes: polygon or lens for the rotation order, hooks for the screw index, and a styled line for a plane, drawn from the classified operations.
:LABEL: Concept

label: ITA height and fraction labels
definition: Printed heights of general-position images (a fraction of the projected coordinate, or a spelled-out coordinate for an inclined axis) and the single-glyph fractions used on the plate.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Coordination polyhedron on a cubic plate
definition: On a cubic plate the general-position images are joined into orthogonal polyhedra over the closed cell, one circle at each corner, instead of a flat height-labelled orbit.
:LABEL: Concept

label: ITA projection convention
definition: The projected cell outline and which axis is down the page: unique axis for a monoclinic group, otherwise c, taken from the operations rather than a stored plate.
:LABEL: Concept

label: a-glide
definition: A glide whose intrinsic translation is half the a edge. _glide_symbol returns the letter a for that reduced translation.
:LABEL: Concept

label: b-glide
definition: A glide whose intrinsic translation is half the b edge. _glide_symbol returns the letter b for that reduced translation.
:LABEL: Concept

label: c-glide
definition: A glide whose intrinsic translation is half the c edge. _glide_symbol returns the letter c for that reduced translation.
:LABEL: Concept

label: n-glide
definition: A diagonal glide of half a face or body diagonal on a coordinate plane. _glide_symbol returns n for that case, and g for the hexagonal and some tetragonal diagonals it does not call n.
:LABEL: Concept

label: d-glide
definition: A diamond glide: a quarter of a face or body diagonal. _glide_symbol returns d when four times the intrinsic translation is integral and two times is not.
:LABEL: Concept

label: e-glide
definition: The double glide IUCr denotes e, used in the 2016 short symbols of five space groups. _glide_symbol never returns e; those and other leftover diagonal glides come back as g, and the Hermann-Mauguin lookup keeps the pre-2016 names.
:LABEL: Concept

label: 2₁ screw axis
definition: A twofold rotation plus half the axis period. _screw_index returns 1 when the intrinsic translation is half the period; the Hall parser reads a screw digit t as translation t/N.
:LABEL: Concept

label: 3₁ screw axis
definition: A threefold rotation plus one third of the axis period. The screw index is 1.
:LABEL: Concept

label: 3₂ screw axis
definition: A threefold rotation plus two thirds of the axis period, the opposite hand of 3₁. The screw index is 2. Intensities are not used to choose between them.
:LABEL: Concept

label: 4₁ screw axis
definition: A fourfold rotation plus one quarter of the axis period. The screw index is 1.
:LABEL: Concept

label: 4₂ screw axis
definition: A fourfold rotation plus half the axis period. The screw index is 2.
:LABEL: Concept

label: 4₃ screw axis
definition: A fourfold rotation plus three quarters of the axis period, the opposite hand of 4₁. The screw index is 3. Intensities are not used to choose between them.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Hexagonal screws 6₁–6₅
definition: Sixfold screws with index 1 through 5: intrinsic translation k/6 of the axis period. _screw_index returns that k; 6₁ and 6₅, and 6₂ and 6₄, are opposite hands.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Chiral space group (Sohncke group)
definition: A space group with no inversion, mirror, glide, or rotoinversion, so it is not identical to its mirror image. Enantiomorphic pairs such as P4₁ and P4₃ are drawn with a comma on the opposite hand. The plate records handedness; intensities are not used to choose which member of a pair.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Symmorphic space group
definition: A space group that has an origin at which every operation's intrinsic translation vanishes, so the group is a semidirect product of a point group and the translation lattice. agentsg sees a zero intrinsic part on an operation; it does not emit a symmorphic flag.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Non-symmorphic space group
definition: A space group whose operations include a screw or a glide that cannot all be cleared by an origin shift. agentsg classifies a nonzero intrinsic part; it does not label the group non-symmorphic.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Geometric crystal class
definition: A conjugacy class of crystallographic point groups in O(3). agentsg derives the point group as the set of rotation parts W; it does not tabulate the 32 geometric classes by name.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Arithmetic crystal class
definition: A conjugacy class of finite subgroups of GL(3,Z): the point group as integer matrices on a lattice basis. The rotation parts agentsg stores are those integer matrices. No arithmetic-class number is tabulated.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Bravais class
definition: An arithmetic crystal class together with the centring type of the lattice: the classification of which the 14 Bravais lattices are the symmorphic members. agentsg distinguishes holohedry and centring letter; it does not emit a Bravais-class symbol.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Wilson statistics (centric and acentric intensities)
definition: The expected distributions of diffracted intensity for centric and acentric reflections, and the epsilon enhancement where the stabilizer of h is larger than 1. agentsg reports the centric phase restriction and the epsilon factor. It does not fit a Wilson plot.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Tolerance-gated cell matching
definition: Two cells match when edges and angles stay inside a named tolerance: metric automorphisms, twin laws, and geometric reindexing use 2 percent and 2 degrees; cell comparison uses 3 percent and 5 degrees; a PDB change of basis uses 0.75 percent and 0.5 degrees, and is accepted at a relative metric residual of 1e-6. This is a numeric gate. It is not the exact certificate given by equality over the Selling closure.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Site-symmetry stratum (direct-space fixed set)
definition: The locus of points in the unit cell with a given site-symmetry stabilizer: the intersection of the fixed-point loci of those operations. This is the direct-space counterpart of a reflection stratum. The two are analogous stratifications by stabilizer, not a lattice dual of each other.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Twinning by pseudomerohedry
definition: Twin laws from a lattice holohedry that only approximately contains the crystal Laue group, so the obliquity is small but not zero. twin_laws and the ambiguity cosets enumerate these operators when the cell is within the length and angle tolerances. The obliquity itself is not reported.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Twinning by reticular merohedry
definition: Twinning in which only a sublattice is restored by the twin operation. Dictionary context. twin_laws enumerates cosets of the Laue group in the lattice holohedry; it does not build a twin lattice or a twin index.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Twin index
definition: The index of the twin lattice in the crystal lattice. Dictionary context. The code does not compute it.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Twin obliquity
definition: The angle by which a twin operation fails to be an exact symmetry of the lattice. Dictionary context. Tolerances gate which operators are returned; the angle is not reported.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Twin lattice
definition: The sublattice restored by every twin operation of a twin. Dictionary context. The code returns twin-law matrices, not that sublattice.
:LABEL: Concept

label: CrystFEL stream
definition: A CrystFEL .stream file: one indexed unit cell, and optionally the reciprocal-lattice orientation, for each crystal in a serial experiment. Cells are converted from nanometres to angstroms.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Indexed cell distribution
definition: The set of per-crystal unit cells written by the indexer, before merging averages them. parse_stream yields one cell dict per indexed crystal.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Reference orbit of Selling superbases
definition: One Selling reduction of a deposited cell, the deposited-to-reduced change of basis, and the labeled closure of obtuse superbases used to match a neighbour.
:LABEL: Concept

label: PDB lattice search pipeline
definition: The same path for a query and for each stored PDB cell: conventional cell, primitive cell from the centring letter, Selling reduction, Kurlin root form, then a KD-tree radius query on the six root components.
literature: Kurlin, V. Mathematics of 2-dimensional and 3-dimensional lattices, arXiv:2201.10543
:LABEL: Concept

label: Klassengleiche subgroup of type IIa
definition: A klassengleiche subgroup on the same conventional cell: the point group stays, and a point-group-invariant proper subset of the centring translations is dropped. Primitive groups have no IIa edge. This is derived from the operators, not from an ITA A1 maximality table.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Klassengleiche subgroup of type IIb
definition: A klassengleiche subgroup of a primitive group from an invariant index-2 or index-3 sublattice of Z³. The point group is kept and the cell is enlarged. Infinite isomorphic series beyond those two indices are not enumerated.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Named numeric gate
definition: The angle, length, conorm, and residual cutoffs for Le Page symmetry, cell comparison, reindexing, and a PDB change of basis. Each number is a named constant in tolerances.py. Le Page uses 3 degrees and 2 percent. Metric automorphisms use 2 percent and 2 degrees. Cell comparison uses 3 percent and 5 degrees. A PDB match uses 0.75 percent and 0.5 degrees, with zero conorms inside 0.05 degrees and a relative boundary of 0.001.
:LABEL: Concept

label: Closure-invariant conorm noise floor
definition: One floor s = c · σ_θ · T applied to every Selling conorm, where T is the sum of the six conorms. Selling flips permute the conorms and leave T fixed, so the floor is the same on every member of the closure. It is not a separate floor on each pair.
literature: Kurlin, V. Mathematics of 2-dimensional and 3-dimensional lattices, arXiv:2201.10543
:LABEL: Concept
